title: High-Throughput Synthesis
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather hardware and consumables
steps.instruction: Place a P1000 single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette and a P300 single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette on the robot, load the P1000 tip rack in Slot 1 and the P300 tip rack in Slot 2, and have Opentrons tube racks and reagent reservoirs ready.

steps.title: Create Vial Map CSV
steps.instruction: Prepare a Vial Map CSV with columns Well Number, Labware, Slot, Well Position; include rows such as 1, opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_2ml_screwcap, 4, A1; 2, opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_2ml_screwcap, 4, A2; 3, opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_2ml_screwcap, 4, A3; … 96, opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_2ml_screwcap, 7, D6. This file defines the labware type, deck slot and well location for each vial.

steps.title: Create High‑Throughput synthesis CSV
steps.instruction: Prepare a High‑Throughput Synthesis Protocol CSV that lists the dispensing volumes from each reservoir for every well (numbering starts from top‑left to top‑right).

steps.title: Upload CSVs and set pipette parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons protocol builder, upload the Vial Map CSV and the High‑Throughput Synthesis CSV, then select pipette mounts, choose tip‑rack slots (P1000 Slot 1, P300 Slot 2), and specify aspiration and dispense heights.

steps.title: Download generated protocol script
steps.instruction: After configuring the parameters, click “Download” to obtain the Python protocol file.

steps.title: Load protocol into OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT App and use “Upload protocol” to import the downloaded script.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the tip racks, reagent reservoirs, and tube racks on the robot deck exactly as described in the Vial Map CSV (e.g., P1000 tips in Slot 1, P300 tips in Slot 2, tube rack in Slot 4 with wells A1‑A3, and additional rack in Slot 7 with well D6).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the OT App calibration routine to calibrate each labware piece, tip rack, and both pipettes using the provided calibration tips.

steps.title: Execute the synthesis
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the high‑throughput synthesis as defined by the CSVs.
